import glob, json, subprocess, sys
fx = sorted(glob.glob('fixture*.json') + glob.glob('toy*.json') + glob.glob('valid*.json'))
greens = reds = 0

assert greens >= 1, 'no passing valid fixture'
assert reds >= 4, 'fewer than 4 tamper fixtures rejected'
